description: Most recorded mammal species in Dataset/observations-794195.csv. All 6,460 species-level observations across 155 species are aggregated and embedded. Subspecies are combined with their parent species using the first two scientific-name components; one genus-only record (Nekrolagus) is excluded. Counts include all dates and records regardless of coordinates. Top N is selected by count descending with scientific name breaking ties, then displayed in the selected sort order. Counts measure recording activity, not animal abundance. Lollipop heads are embedded cartoon SVG animal portraits for all Top 15 species; portrait centres mark the observation counts and their size is constant. Species colours match the ten-species palette in BumpChart.vg.json; species selection and observation counts are unchanged.
